items.question: Will OpenAI and Stripe move ACP to a neutral foundation?
items.context: The governance document names a foundation as a long-term goal with four preconditions; today the founders appoint the TSC and hold a veto on SEPs.

items.question: What do the six newer checkout statuses mean?
items.context: incomplete, requires_escalation, pending_approval, complete_in_progress and expired, plus authentication_required, appear in the schema; only authentication_required has behavior in the RFC text.

items.question: Who besides ChatGPT runs ACP checkout in production?
items.context: Microsoft, PayPal and Walmart made announcements, and Microsoft's later merchant page asks for UCP feeds. No primary source confirms live ACP checkout on another surface.

items.question: Will the spec and OpenAI's implementation converge?
items.context: Feed paths, webhook names, status codes and TLS versions differ between the spec and OpenAI's docs, and nobody has said which side will change.

items.question: Will ACP get a user-intent layer?
items.context: The Verifiable Intent project proposes carrying its credentials through ACP extensions; the maintainers have not adopted it.

items.question: How should PSPs report allowance violations?
items.context: ACP defines the allowance but no error codes for a charge outside it, so each PSP picks its own.

items.question: Is the repository still active?
items.context: No commit landed between 2026-07-18 and 2026-10-11, after 18 commits following the 2026-04-17 release.

items.question: How much commerce runs over ACP?
items.context: No official volume, GMV or merchant count exists; the only figures are partner lists and a reported remark that about a dozen Shopify merchants sold through AI tools in March 2026.
